  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer

About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Junte-se a nós!

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).

  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.

  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.

Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).

  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).
  • Garantir clareza de premissas e limites das soluções (dados, regras e critérios), com documentação e governança para adoção e manutenção.
  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

title: Automotive Project/Release Manager
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

Tools & Ways of Working

title: Sales Account Executive (Closer)
description:
About Us


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We work alongside ambitious SaaS teams as long-term design partners, helping translate complex challenges into meaningful user experiences that support real business growth.


Our approach is embedded, focused on partnership and outcomes, rather than transactions. While UX/UI is at our core, we support everything design-related — from product and web to motion, graphic design, and branding.


About the Role


We’re looking for a high-ownership, consultative Account Executive to drive new business for Foundey. This is an end-to-end sales role where you’ll own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through discovery, strategic alignment, proposal development, and close. You’ll work directly with founders, product leaders, and engineering executives at fast-growing SaaS and AI companies.


Success in this role requires strong discovery skills, the ability to diagnose product and growth challenges, and comfort selling high-value design engagements. This is not a transactional sales motion. It requires both commercial sharpness and genuine empathy — someone who listens deeply, understands a founder’s context and constraints, and builds trust through thoughtful, consultative conversations, not just pressure-driven tactics.


What You’ll Do


  • Own and close B2B SaaS deals end-to-end, working with cutting edge startups to Series A/B organizations
  • Generate outbound pipeline and build opportunities from scratch
  • Sell SaaS, technology solutions, or tech-enabled services (especially UX/UI, but also graphic, web and motion design services)
  • Lead strategic discovery calls with senior decision-makers
  • Run compelling discovery calls and live working sessions, along with delivering executive-level presentations
  • Multi-thread deals across stakeholders
  • Drive negotiations with confidence
  • Maintain disciplined forecasting and deal control
  • Consistently exceed aggressive revenue quotas


What We’re Looking For


  • Minimum 3+ years of B2B sales experience
  • Strong experience closing enterprise SaaS and/or Technology Solutions ○ Bonus: UX/UI service deals
  • Proven, documented track record of exceeding quota
  • Experience selling to startups and scale-ups, especially within North America
  • Deep understanding of selling technology to product-driven companies
  • Native or fluent English (mandatory)
  • Exceptional closing, negotiation, and objection-handling skills
  • Executive presence and strong communication
  • Highly competitive, resilient, and performance-driven
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and early-stage environments

Must-haves


  • You have demonstrated closing opportunities from end-to-end
  • Take full ownership of achieving your quarterly quota / goals
  • You thrive in a high pace environment
  • Demonstrated the ability to close multi-threaded deals
  • Ability to work with multiple Buyer Personas - Founders, CEOs, CIO/CTO, VP of Engineering

Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Field Sales Representative
description:
Sobre o Grupo Lesso

LESSO (código de bolsa: 02128.HK) é um grupo líder mundial na indústria de materiais de construção de tubulações. Fundado em 1986, seu âmbito comercial abrange tubulações, materiais de construção para o lar, proteção ambiental, novas energias e plataformas de serviços de cadeia de suprimentos. Os produtos incluem tubulações, energia solar fotovoltaica, canalizações e banheiros, cozinhas integradas, portas e janelas integradas, cofragens de alumínio e andaimes inteligentes, equipamentos de purificação de água, impermeabilizantes e selantes, equipamentos contra incêndios, válvulas, cabos elétricos, iluminação, materiais sanitários, proteção ambiental, instalações agrícolas, redes de gaiolas marinhas para aquicultura, entre outros campos. Em 2023, a receita operacional do Grupo atingiu 4,38 bilhões de dólares.


Resumo da Vaga

Estamos expandindo nossa equipe de vendas e estamos procurando um REPRESENTANTE DE VENDAS EXTERNO motivado no Brasil para ajudar a acelerar o crescimento na sua região designada. Nesta função, você será um parceiro vital para o Gerente de Vendas, com foco na aquisição de novos clientes e na expansão da nossa presença.


Principais Responsabilidades

1.Realizar atividades de vendas externas no território designado, de acordo com a estratégia de vendas da empresa.

2.Visitar proativamente clientes potenciais e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio.

3.0Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com distribuidores, atacadistas, empreiteiros e clientes de projetos.

4.Coletar e encaminhar leads qualificados de clientes e projetos para a gerência e para a matriz.

5.Manter o relacionamento com os clientes existentes e apoiar a reincidência de negócios.

6.Monitorar as condições do mercado local, os preços e as atividades da concorrência.

7.Alcançar os KPIs atribuídos relacionados a visitas a clientes, prospecção e suporte de vendas.


Requisitos

1.Formação técnica, bacharelato ou superior.

2.1 a 3 anos de experiência em vendas, vendas externas ou desenvolvimento de canais.

3.Familiarizado com o mercado local e disposto a realizar visitas de campo frequentes.

4.Fortes habilidades de comunicação, execução e desenvolvimento de clientes.

6.Domínio do português; inglês básico é um diferencial.

6.Preferencialmente com experiência em materiais de construção, tubulações, produtos industriais ou energias renováveis.


Esclarecimento Importante sobre a Função

Este é um cargo de vendas baseado em trabalho de campo, onde a maior parte do tempo de trabalho é dedicada a visitar clientes;

O foco inicial é a entrada no mercado, o desenvolvimento de clientes e a geração de leads;

Esta posição não é adequada para candidatos que buscam apenas um posto de trabalho de escritório.


Remuneração e Benefícios

Salário fixo mais comissão sobre vendas e/ou bônus por desempenho.

Despesas de viagem e transporte relacionadas ao negócio reembolsadas conforme política da empresa.

Oportunidades claras de desenvolvimento de carreira dentro da organização.


Período de Experiência e Avaliação de Metas (KPIs)

O período de experiência é de 3 meses.

O desempenho será avaliado com base na execução das atividades de campo, leads qualificados, feedback do mercado e postura profissional.

Os candidatos aprovados serão efetivados como funcionários regulares ao cumprirem as metas (KPIs) do período de experiência.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Analista Sênior de Monitoria de Fornecedores
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.


Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!


Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?

• Garantir que o owner do contrato realize a avaliação contínua da qualidade dos serviços contratados, incluindo prazos, custos, nível de serviço e inovação.

• Aplicar, acompanhar e analisar KPIs e SLAs, assegurando aderência aos contratos e identificando oportunidades de melhoria.

• Apoiar reuniões periódicas de alinhamento entre Zurich Santander e fornecedores estratégicos.

• Estruturar e acompanhar planos de ação e programas de melhoria contínua, promovendo evolução de performance.

• Fomentar a capacitação dos fornecedores e o desenvolvimento de parcerias de longo prazo.

• Monitorar a conformidade entre pagamentos e contratos, garantindo aderência às condições acordadas.

• Assegurar a conformidade entre os serviços realizados e os serviços contratados.

• Atuar nos processos de descontinuidade de fornecedores, quando aplicável.

• Apoiar e estruturar a gestão de transição (plano de saída), garantindo continuidade operacional e mitigação de riscos.

• Elaborar relatórios executivos de performance e risco para suporte à tomada de decisão.

• Identificar oportunidades de inovação e eficiência nos serviços prestados.


Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

• Formação superior completa (Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Direito ou áreas correlatas).

• Experiência prévia em gestão, monitoramento ou desenvolvimento de fornecedores.

• Vivência com gestão de contratos e análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e SLAs).

• Conhecimento em governança de terceiros e gestão de riscos.

• Capacidade analítica e habilidade para trabalhar com dados e relatórios.

• Experiência na condução de reuniões com stakeholders internos e externos.

• Conhecimento em processos de melhoria contínua.

• Domínio em Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Apps.


Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

• Experiência no setor de seguros, bancário ou serviços financeiros.

• Vivência com fornecedores críticos e estratégicos.

• Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares).

• Experiência em gestão de transição e processos de descontinuidade contratual.

• Perfil com forte capacidade de influência, negociação e gestão de conflitos.

• Forte senso de dono e autonomia.

• Capacidade analítica para suportar tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

• Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças.


Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor ?

Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.


Junte-se à nossa equipe!

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Key Responsibilities

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.

title: Analista de sistemas pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga
A NETRA está em busca de talentos para fazer parte de uma jornada de transformação digital. Acreditamos no ser humano como peça fundamental nessa caminhada e você pode fazer parte dessa trajetória.
Faça parte da mudança!
Buscamos por um Analista de Sistemas Pleno para atuar em Salvador-BA.
Responsabilidades e atribuições Diariamente esse profissional vai:
Desenvolver aplicações utilizando linguagens como PHP, Java, Java Script, Python, Type Script, Kotlin , além de tecnologias React, React Native, Android, HTML e CSS , entre outras linguagens de alto nível com interface gráfica. Utilizar os principais frameworks associados às linguagens mencionadas. Realização de modelagem, implementação e manutenção de bancos de dados Microsoft SQL Server, My SQL e Postgre SQL , em ambientes cliente/servidor e web. Atuar com foco em UI/UX , contribuindo na definição e melhoria da experiência e interface do usuário. Utilizar de forma avançada o Git Lab para versionamento, controle de código e gestão de branches. Participar de reuniões operacionais e acompanhamento do plano de trabalho, exercendo controle sobre prazos e entregas, bem como notificando coordenadores sobre riscos ou possíveis problemas futuros.
Realizar análises técnicas e programação sempre que necessário ou previsto no plano de trabalho.
Conduzir treinamentos e elaborar manuais para implantação das soluções desenvolvidas.
Atuar com metodologias ágeis , colaborando em rituais e práticas voltadas à melhoria contínua dos processos. Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos para organização, acompanhamento e entrega das demandas.
Desenvolver aplicativos móveis para Android e i OS .
Requisitos e qualificações
Se ligue que você precisa de:
Ensino superior completo.
Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas web e mobile.
Domínio das linguagens e frameworks mencionados.
Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, My SQL e Postgre SQL).
Certificação SFC (Scrum Fundaments Certified).
Conhecimento avançado em versionamento com Git Lab . Experiência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos.
Mas vai ser ótimo : conhecer plataformas digitais de design de interface do usuário (UI) e experiência do usuário (UX).
Benefícios
Total Pass;
Benefício refeição/alimentação (i Food);
Assistência médica;
Assistência psicológica;
Assistência odontológica;
Parcerias com instituições de ensino (escolas e universidades), restaurantes, entre outros;
Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
Na Netra, acreditamos que a tecnologia só faz sentido quando aproxima pessoas, impulsiona negócios e promove mudanças reais na sociedade. Há 25 anos, desenvolvemos soluções digitais sob medida para os desafios do setor público e privado, sempre com o compromisso de inovar com propósito.
Fazemos parte de um ecossistema de parceiros globais e contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar que combina experiência, criatividade e visão de futuro. Aqui, valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado contínuo e a diversidade como forças que nos ajudam a ir além.
Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde suas ideias têm espaço para crescer e gerar impacto, a Netra é o lugar certo. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!
